title: Australia police refute authenticity of missing-boy image (AFP Fact Check)
why: [fact-check (surreal specimen)] Claim: Instagram/Facebook “potential breakthrough” posts (Celebrity Today, ~200k followers) collage a man carrying a curly-haired child into a car ~100km from Yunta as a “crucial lead.” SA Police tell AFP the carrying image is “not factual”; warped fingers and a floating ghost-tree give the AI away. Real Gus photo a…
